chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who gifts the slave girl to the husband of his daughter, and he had copulated with her. Can the husband of his daughter copulate with her? He said: There is no problem with it.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it
key_terms.لِزَوْجِ ابْنَتِهِ: to the husband of his daughter

ai.seo_question: Can a father's wife (slave girl) be shared between the father and his son-in-law?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS), the permissibility of the son-in-law consummating the marriage with a slave girl gifted by her father is affirmed, highlighting the flexibility of ownership rights in early Islamic jurisprudence. This ruling underscores that the father's prior possession does not invalidate the husband's right to intimacy, reflecting the practical legal norms of the time regarding concubinage and marital unions within the extended family structure.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Abu Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who gifted the slave girl to the husband of his daughter (son-in-law), and he had copulated with her. Can his son-in-law copulate with her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Kufiy ibn Jabalah from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a man who gives as a gift his slave- girl with whom he has gone to bed, to his son in-law; if his son in-law can go to bed with this slave- girl. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’”
